title: NaturalBench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Natural Adversarial Samples

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on carefully paired image-question samples with alternating correct answers to penalize models relying on text-only priors or fixed answer patterns (e.g., defaulting to 'Yes' or 'B'). The paper also quantifies these biases by testing 'blind' text-only models and applies threshold-tuning debiasing techniques on the generative likelihoods (VQAScore) to mitigate answer repetition.
